tasks.empty_tasks_definition: Tasks are specific and time-bound missions, like tidying up the room in the afternoon or learning a poem. The main difference for the child is that routines automate daily useful actions, while tasks teach reaching unique goals.
tasks.empty_habits_definition: Routines are daily, mandatory tasks that are repeated every day to create healthy habits, like brushing teeth or doing exercises. Tasks are specific and time-bound missions, like tidying up the room in the afternoon or learning a poem.
tasks.empty_tasks_habits_difference: The main difference for the child is that routines automate daily useful actions, while tasks teach reaching unique goals.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.forFamiliesDescription: Connect with your kids through meaningful task management
welcome.addYourChildrenDescription:
Start by creating a profile for each of your children. Include their name, date of birth, a fun avatar and a color of their card.
Parent with the rights of admin also can add other parents or person who can review the completion of tasks and routine.
Parents can manage multiple children from one dashboard.
welcome.createTasksAndRoutinesDescription:
Design tasks that match your family needs. Set point values, due dates, recurrence patterns and assign them to particular children. 
You control everything!
welcome.childrenCompletionAndEarnDescription:
Kids see their daily tasks in a simple, fun interface. They mark tasks as done with one tap.
For each completed task, they earn points and progress toward their goals
welcome.parentApprovalAndRewardsDescription:
Review completed tasks and approve them ( or reject).
Create a reward catalogue so kids can redeem their points for real prizes they love
welcome.intro: The modern family task management application that turns everyday chores into fun, rewarding experiences.
welcome.intro2: We help families work together, build useful habits and celebrate achievements!
welcome.insightsDescription: Real-time data on completion rates and family progress
welcome.motivationDescription: Points, badges and rewards that make kids excited to help
welcome.subtitle: Complete your profile
welcome.welcome_steps: Let’s get your profile set up in a few quick steps.
